task: Audit audit-target against its SPEC.md for correctness defects. Parallel finder subagents on distinct angles, then fresh verifier subagents independently confirm/refute each candidate. Log all worker actions with worker ids to audit-target/workflow-log.jsonl. Do not modify any file under audit-target other than the log.

workers.goal: Charter: line-by-line spec conformance. For every bullet in SPEC.md, check whether inventory/stock.py and inventory/report.py implement it exactly as written. Report each mismatch as a finding with file:line evidence. Done when every SPEC.md bullet has been checked and a verdict recorded.

Charter: numeric/type correctness. Audit dollar-to-cent conversions, CSV field parsing, rounding/formatting, and unit consistency between SPEC.md and the code. Report each mismatch as a finding with file:line evidence. Done when all numeric/unit-conversion paths (add, remove, total_value_cents, parse_csv_line, format_report) have been checked.

Charter: state-mutation and edge-case correctness. Audit missing-key handling, quantity validation, mutable-default hazards, add/remove interactions, and boundary conditions (qty=0, negative qty, empty ledger, unknown sku). Report each mismatch against SPEC.md as a finding with file:line evidence. Done when add/remove/low_stock/total_value_cents have each been checked for these edge cases.

Independently confirm or refute every candidate finding assigned (produced by finder-spec-line). Do not trust the finder's claim; re-derive each verdict yourself from SPEC.md and the code, and actually execute a small repro for behavioural claims. Done when every assigned candidate has an explicit confirm/refute verdict with fresh evidence.
inputs: candidate findings from finder-spec-line (embedded in dispatch packet)
